section.8: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Injunctions about Witr

8.name_native: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Injunctions about Witr

hadiths.text: Sahl b. Hunaif reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If anyone asks Allah for martyrdom sincerely, Allah will make him reach the ranks of martyrs even if he died on his bed
